cases.requirement: clamp(value, minimum, maximum) must return minimum below range, maximum above range, and the original value inside the inclusive range.
cases.code:
def clamp(value, minimum, maximum):
    return max(minimum, min(value, maximum))
cases.assistant_rationale: The nested min/max implementation satisfies lower, interior, and upper boundary behavior.

cases.requirement: safe_divide(left, right) must return None when right is zero and otherwise return normal floating-point division.
cases.assistant_rationale: Zero is handled explicitly and nonzero operands use standard division.

cases.requirement: is_palindrome(text) must ignore case and non-alphanumeric characters.

tests.expression: is_palindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!')

cases.assistant_rationale: The normalized string removes punctuation, folds case, and is compared with its reverse.

cases.requirement: paginate(items, page, size) uses one-based page numbers and returns the requested slice; page 1 starts at index 0.
cases.assistant_rationale: The start offset correctly converts one-based pages to zero-based slicing.

cases.requirement: parse_bool(value) must accept true/1/yes and false/0/no case-insensitively and raise ValueError for any other value.
cases.assistant_rationale: Both accepted groups and the invalid-input branch are implemented explicitly.

cases.requirement: average(values) must return None for an empty collection and the arithmetic mean otherwise.
cases.assistant_rationale: The empty case is guarded and normal values use true division.

cases.requirement: deduplicate(items) must preserve first-seen order and must not mutate the input list.
cases.assistant_rationale: A separate result list preserves order and leaves the source untouched.

cases.requirement: binary_search(items, target) receives a sorted list and returns the matching index or -1 when absent.
cases.assistant_rationale: Bounds advance correctly, equality returns the index, and absence returns -1.

cases.requirement: retry_delay(attempt, base, maximum) must return exponentially doubled delay base*2**attempt capped at maximum.
cases.code:
def retry_delay(attempt, base, maximum):
    return min(maximum, base * (2 ** attempt))
cases.assistant_rationale: The exponential expression is bounded by the configured maximum.

cases.requirement: build_sort_query(column) may interpolate only the exact allowed columns name or created_at and must reject every other value.

tests.expected: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY name

cases.assistant_rationale: Interpolation is safe here because membership uses an exact set whitelist.

cases.requirement: render_trusted_admin_html(markup) receives only pre-sanitized, administrator-authored markup and must return it unchanged; sanitization is explicitly outside this function.
cases.code:
def render_trusted_admin_html(markup):
    return markup
cases.assistant_rationale: The trust boundary is explicit and unchanged passthrough is the stated behavior, despite the code looking like a generic XSS sink.

cases.requirement: build_git_status_args(path) must return an argument list for a later shell-free subprocess call and must not execute anything.
cases.code:
def build_git_status_args(path):
    return ['git', 'status', '--short', '--', path]
cases.assistant_rationale: Returning an argv list does not execute a shell; the metacharacters remain one inert argument.

cases.requirement: redact_known_secret(text, secret) must replace every exact occurrence of the supplied secret with [REDACTED]. It is not a general secret detector.
cases.assistant_rationale: Exact configured-secret replacement is narrower than general redaction but fully matches this contract.

cases.requirement: parse_python_literal(text) must parse Python literal data without executing arbitrary code; ast.literal_eval is required.
cases.assistant_rationale: ast.literal_eval accepts literals without the arbitrary execution behavior of eval.

cases.requirement: secure_equal(left, right) must compare secrets with the standard constant-time comparison helper.
cases.assistant_rationale: hmac.compare_digest is the standard constant-time helper requested by the contract.

cases.requirement: clamp(value, minimum, maximum) must return minimum below range, maximum above range, and the original value inside the inclusive range.
cases.code:
def clamp(value, minimum, maximum):
    return min(minimum, max(value, maximum))
cases.assistant_rationale: The min/max operands are reversed, causing interior and upper values to collapse to the minimum.

cases.requirement: safe_divide(left, right) must return None when right is zero and otherwise return normal floating-point division.
cases.assistant_rationale: The guard handles negative denominators rather than zero, so zero raises and valid negative division is rejected.

cases.requirement: is_palindrome(text) must ignore case and non-alphanumeric characters.
cases.code:
def is_palindrome(text):
    return text == text[::-1]

tests.expression: is_palindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!')

cases.assistant_rationale: Direct reversal does not implement either required normalization step.

cases.requirement: paginate(items, page, size) uses one-based page numbers and returns the requested slice; page 1 starts at index 0.
cases.assistant_rationale: The start offset treats page as zero-based and skips the first page.

cases.requirement: parse_bool(value) must accept true/1/yes and false/0/no case-insensitively and raise ValueError for any other value.
cases.code:
def parse_bool(value):
    return bool(value)
cases.assistant_rationale: Python string truthiness makes every non-empty string True and never validates allowed tokens.

cases.requirement: average(values) must return None for an empty collection and the arithmetic mean otherwise, including fractional results.
cases.assistant_rationale: Floor division loses the required fractional portion.

cases.requirement: deduplicate(items) must preserve first-seen order and must not mutate the input list.
cases.assistant_rationale: Sorting mutates the input and replaces first-seen order with sorted order.

cases.requirement: binary_search(items, target) receives a sorted list and returns the matching index or -1 when absent.
cases.code:
def binary_search(items, target):
    return target in items
cases.assistant_rationale: Membership booleans do not satisfy the required index/-1 return contract.

cases.requirement: retry_delay(attempt, base, maximum) must return exponentially doubled delay base*2**attempt capped at maximum.
cases.code:
def retry_delay(attempt, base, maximum):
    return base * (2 ** attempt)
cases.assistant_rationale: The maximum parameter is ignored, allowing unbounded retry delays.

cases.requirement: build_sort_query(column) may interpolate only the exact allowed columns name or created_at and must reject every other value.
cases.assistant_rationale: Substring membership accepts fragments such as me, violating exact whitelisting.

cases.requirement: render_user_comment(markup) receives untrusted user input and must HTML-escape angle brackets and ampersands before returning it.
cases.code:
def render_user_comment(markup):
    return markup
cases.assistant_rationale: Untrusted markup is returned without the required escaping, creating an XSS sink.

cases.requirement: git_status(path) must invoke Git without a shell and must keep path as a separate argument.
cases.assistant_rationale: String concatenation into os.system enables shell injection and violates shell-free execution.

cases.requirement: redact_token_assignment(text) must redact token=VALUE case-insensitively wherever it appears.
cases.assistant_rationale: The lowercase-only search misses uppercase and mixed-case assignments required by the contract.

cases.requirement: is_within(root, candidate) must return True only when candidate is root itself or a descendant separated by a slash; sibling prefixes must be rejected.
cases.code:
def is_within(root, candidate):
    return candidate.startswith(root)
cases.assistant_rationale: Raw prefix matching accepts sibling paths that merely share the root text.

cases.requirement: cache values must be isolated by both owner_id and resource_id so two users cannot overwrite or read each other's entry.
cases.assistant_rationale: The cache key omits owner_id, so Bob's value overwrites Alice's and creates cross-owner leakage.
